system.description:
Tutored by a single master rather than any institution: no lecture hall, no cohort, just a master's attention and very high expectations.

  • Steady Hand: Advantage on saves against your own spells' backlash or unintended effects. When you fail to keep a spell after being damaged while casting, you keep its slot.
    • 9th level: once per day, you keep the spell as well.
  • Master's Name: Advantage on checks with your master's peers, and on identifying magic made by your master's school.
